goals: Verify the DOM presence and absence of the LoadingOverlay component based on its active prop and state transitions, including delayed removal.
Verify the LoadingOverlay component's interactive behavior, specifically handling click events on the overlay.
activities: Render the LoadingOverlay component with active implicitly false.
Assert that the wrapper element contains no children.
Render the LoadingOverlay component with active explicitly true.
Assert that the wrapper element contains one child.
Initialize a flag variable 'clicked' to false.
Render the LoadingOverlay component with active set to true and an onClick handler.
Simulate a click event on the overlay element.
Assert that the 'clicked' flag is now true.
Render the DelayedInactive component, which initially sets active to true and schedules a state update to active: false after 600ms.
Assert that the wrapper element contains one child.
Advance all pending timers, triggering the state update in DelayedInactive to active: false.
Assert that the wrapper element contains no children.
Render the DelayedInactive component, which initially sets active to true and schedules a state update to active: false after 600ms.
Assert that the wrapper element contains one child.
Advance only the pending timers, triggering the state update in DelayedInactive to active: false.
Assert that the wrapper element still contains one child.
Assert that the wrapper element now contains no children.
